name: Autoresearch-Style Compiler Bootstrap Pipeline
description: Measurement and intervention substrate for future frontier-model systems-programming evaluations (Claude vs GPT, aided vs unaided, real systems tasks). The compiler runtime + scorer + benchmark regime are the apparatus; the downstream product is the ability to answer whether structured compiler assistance changes what frontier models can do on hard engineering work, and at what cost. Program purpose canon: docs/architecture/COMP_LEARNS_PROGRAM_PURPOSE.md. Phase structure: Phase 1 runtime hardening (active); Phase 2 target diversification (queued); Phase 3 task suite design (unscaffolded); Phase 4 experimental protocol (unscaffolded); Phase 5 comparative evals (unscaffolded). Local implementation root: `comp/`. Modeled on Karpathy's autoresearch three-file separation (fixed harness / mutable target / slow-evolving protocol). Transferable artifact: `comp/program.md` accrues into the generalized 'how to build a compiler for an arbitrary system' skill across target runs.
